n: Utah State Scratch repeat loops for multiplication and exponents (Cache Code Math)
t: Fifth grade lessons that link Scratch repeat loops to multiplication and exponents.
steps: Find the Cache Code Math lesson PDFs from Utah State University.
Download the lab lessons and the math lessons.
Open Scratch in a browser on a lab computer.
Pick the version without Scratch logins.
Plan the order so the lab lesson supports the math lesson.
Try the first repeat loop activity yourself.
Check whether the internet is needed in your lab.
